title: Women's Flyfishing

services.name: Speed Fly Fishing 101
services.desc: Embark on an unforgettable journey with our all-inclusive fly fishing trips, tailored for adventurous women and couples. Glide through serene waters or trek to remote tundras, Women’s Fly Fishing offers a diverse range of destinations. At Women’s Fly Fishing we meticulously plan exclusive trips across the world for sassy sidekicks and sweethearts. Experience the thrill of fishing with fellow fishing ladies and create lasting memories for your next vacation! October 22-26, 2026Join a women-only fly-fishing retreat at Louisiana's Woodland Plantation, an ideal mix of Redfish angling, relaxation, and camaraderie in the Mississippi River Delta, perfect for both experienced anglers and newcomers.

services.name: Half-Day Float Tube
services.desc: Join us for a half-day float tube experience!The fly-fishing float will be at a lake of your choosing in the Anchorage or MatSu Valley area, with up to two other guests (max of three). Adventure out with a small group for an afternoon of float tubing, fly fishing fun! Cancellation / refund policy: Full amount of float tube cost is due at time of booking. Should you cancel your trip, a refund will be issued minus a 10% service charge. We make no refunds nor assume any additional expenses if weather or any reason beyond our control renders you unable to complete a trip or any other part of an itinerary. Documents: You will need to purchase or have a current, active Alaskan Fishing License.

blurb: Reconnect with nature, with fellow female anglers, and with your flow state.
